name: dev-toolkit
description: Atomic development skills — engineering conventions, working methods, and check-and-verdict passes. Each one stands alone, triggers on its own subject matter, and assumes nothing about who invoked it, so they compose freely rather than only inside a pipeline.

interface.shortDescription: Atomic engineering conventions, methods and checks
interface.longDescription: Standalone development skills across four kinds — conventions that say how code, SQL, infrastructure and docs should look; methods that describe how to run a working loop such as TDD, debugging, e2e execution or intent clarification; checks that take code or a page and return a pass/fail verdict on accessibility, security, performance or code smell; and grounded research techniques for probing an API, a data source or a library's real source. Every skill triggers on its own subject and names no caller, so they work equally well invoked directly or composed into a larger flow.
